title: create tree
explanation:
### Description

This example creates a labelled tree with vertex and edge labels displayed using a hierarchical tree layout. The tree is built from a directed graph using AddChild and converted to a vtkTree. Labels are rendered using vtkLabeledDataMapper.

**dataset → input → filter → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) applies the tree layout strategy.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) converts graph edges to polydata lines.
- [vtkLabeledDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabeledDataMapper.html) renders text labels at point positions.
- [vtkMutableDirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableDirectedGraph.html) builds the directed graph using AddChild.
- [vtkStringArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStringArray.html) stores vertex and edge label strings.
- [vtkTree](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTree.html) represents the validated tree structure.
- [vtkTreeLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTreeLayoutStrategy.html) arranges tree nodes hierarchically.
